reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Rain Bird IQ4
reauth_confirm.description: IQ4 rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current IQ4 cloud password.

error.controller_not_found: This account no longer has access to the configured controller

abort.no_controllers: No IQ4 controllers were found for this account

init.title: Local control
init.description: Optional local connection for realtime status and admin-only start and stop actions. Use the controller-local PIN, not the IQ4 cloud password.

error.local_credentials_required: Enter both a local controller host and controller-local PIN

start_station.name: Start station
start_station.description: Waters one enabled station for a fixed time. Refused unless the controller is idle, rain sensor and rain delay are clear, and the station is enabled in IQ4.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: The Rain Bird IQ4 controller to water from.

station_id.name: Station ID
station_id.description: The IQ4 cloud station ID (shown in the station sensor attributes), not the terminal number.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: Run time in whole minutes, from 1 to 30.

stop_irrigation.name: Stop irrigation
stop_irrigation.description: Stops all watering on the controller. Works without the IQ4 cloud; does nothing if the controller is confirmed idle.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: The Rain Bird IQ4 controller to stop.

invalid_device.message: Device {device_id} is not a Rain Bird IQ4 controller.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Rain Bird IQ4 entry {title} is not loaded.

local_not_configured.message: Local control is not configured for {title}. Add the controller address and PIN in the integration options.

invalid_duration.message: Duration must be a whole number of minutes from 1 to 30.

station_not_found.message: That station ID does not belong to this controller.

station_not_enabled.message: That station is not confirmed enabled in IQ4.

cloud_data_unavailable.message: Current IQ4 station data is unavailable, so the station cannot be confirmed enabled.

telemetry_unavailable.message: No local controller status is available yet.

telemetry_stale.message: Local controller status is out of date.

telemetry_incomplete.message: Local controller status is incomplete, so idle cannot be confirmed.

telemetry_refresh_failed.message: Could not read controller status before starting. Nothing was sent.

controller_not_idle.message: The controller is not confirmed idle. Stop the current run first.

irrigation_disabled.message: Irrigation is not confirmed enabled on the controller.

terminal_unavailable.message: The station's terminal is not confirmed available on the controller.

rain_state_unknown.message: Rain sensor or rain delay state is unknown, so starting is blocked.

rain_sensor_active.message: The rain sensor is active, so starting is blocked.

rain_delay_active.message: A rain delay is active, so starting is blocked.

controller_unreachable.message: Could not connect to the controller. Nothing was sent.

write_outcome_ambiguous.message: The command may or may not have reached the controller. It was not retried; check the controller state before trying again.
